scope: Actual packaged GUI, real mouse clicks and nonclient/splitter drags; controlled CMD stdout; no physical devices
limits: Finite bounded stress, no eight-hour soak claim
Finite screen samples do not prove absence of every inter-frame artifact

pet_fixture.input: one real drag after observed native capture

recordings.capture: GetDC(NULL) + BitBlt from actual visible desktop; no PrintWindow; cursor excluded
recordings.codec: FFV1 level 3, RGB lossless (bgr0), intra frames, CRC; nominal-rate playback
